video_title: FULL: AJ Dybantsa on joining the Washington Wizards, his love of basketball, and more

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his early basketball development through Spider-Man
quotes.excerpt: my dad bought me a Spider-Man board. It was like a basketball hoop that went on the back
quotes.quote: My dad bought me a Spider-Man board. It was like a basketball hoop that went on the back of my door and I was just shooting on it, and that is how I fell in love and just wanted to play basketball.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on the competitive nature of basketball
quotes.excerpt: I just like the competitiveness of it. I think there are so many places in basketball
quotes.quote: I just like the competitiveness of it. I think there are so many places in basketball where it can give you an ooh and an ah. It is so exciting to watch. Some sports might be a little more boring to some fans, but I think basketball is a sport where you can do so many things.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on managing high expectations with the Wizards
quotes.excerpt: Just be myself, keep my work ethic, keep staying in the gym, and I should be fine.
quotes.quote: Just be myself, keep my work ethic, keep staying in the gym, and I should be fine. Definitely it is going to be a whirlwind, there is going to be ups and downs, but just staying true to myself and putting the work in, I should be all right.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his playing style comparison to Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: I seen him on TikTok, there was a dude that put me better than Michael Jordan.
quotes.quote: I seen him on TikTok, there was a dude that put me better than Michael Jordan. I believe Michael Jordan is the GOAT, so I decided to watch the video and see he was 6'6, 220 with a 40-inch vertical, and I was like that kind of sounds like me. So I decided to watch some film, I seen him get into his mid-range a lot and I take pride in my mid-range, so I kind of seen the comparison a little bit.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his NBA player comparisons
quotes.excerpt: Some people say younger Paul George. I have heard a bigger Shai, I have heard a bigger Jalen Brunson.
quotes.quote: Some people say younger Paul George. I have heard a bigger Shai, I have heard a bigger Jalen Brunson. But the most accurate one I have ever got was Chase Budinger. I think he was just super uber-talented, being 6'9, jumping over people to shoot, being a windmill, and being super athletic. I think that is kind of me.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on learning from Trae Young and Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: I am definitely grateful that the Wizards picked up Trae and picked up AD.
quotes.quote: I am definitely grateful that the Wizards picked up Trae and picked up AD. I am going to have vets, I am going to have a guy that wants a championship, I am going to have a guy that is a multiple-time All-Star that I can ask questions to.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his short and long-term NBA goals
quotes.excerpt: Long-term goal, I mean definitely win a championship. Short-term goal, make it to the playoffs in year one.
quotes.quote: Long-term goal, I mean definitely win a championship. It is pretty easy to just say it, but it is definitely not easy to do it. But a short-term goal, I will say make it to the playoffs in year one.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on the importance of winning Rookie of the Year
quotes.excerpt: I definitely want to win Rookie of the Year, but it is not like my main attention.
quotes.quote: I definitely want to win Rookie of the Year, but it is not like my main attention. I definitely want to get more wins first, but the more wins I have, if we make the playoffs, I think Rookie of the Year will come.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his commitment to community service
quotes.excerpt: I have been giving back since I was about in ninth grade, eighth grade, ninth grade.
quotes.quote: I have been giving back since I was about in ninth grade, eighth grade, ninth grade is probably when I started. Every new home that I have been to, Provo, then back to Boston, now DC, I am definitely trying to get back and I will do it.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his approach to the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: Definitely just staying in the lab with the guys, getting to know the guys off the court.
quotes.quote: Definitely just staying in the lab with the guys, getting to know the guys off the court and on the court, seeing where they like the ball, seeing what spots they want. So some of these will come up in training camp and then, ultimately, the season.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his potential for further physical development
quotes.excerpt: I am only 19 years old, so I probably, I mean I hope I am not done growing.
quotes.quote: I am only 19 years old, so I probably, I mean I hope I am not done growing. So hopefully I can grow, put some more weight on, I can only shoot the ball even better, I can only get even faster, and I think I can just be super talented.
